name: Four of a Kind
description: Four of a Kind is a unique pokerndstyle betting game, traditionally played as a 'dealer's choice' option in home poker games. Unlike standard poker where you build a hand through drawing or communal cards, players in this game are each assigned a unique starting rank and wait for the deck to provide the matching cards. It is a game of high tension and split pots, where victory is divided between the first person to complete their set of four and the person holding the mathematically lowest hand at that moment.

content.text: Four of a Kind is a unique pokerndstyle betting game, traditionally played as a 'dealer's choice' option in home poker games. Unlike standard poker where you build a hand through drawing or communal cards, players in this game are each assigned a unique starting rank and wait for the deck to provide the matching cards. It is a game of high tension and split pots, where victory is divided between the first person to complete their set of four and the person holding the mathematically lowest hand at that moment.

The game was documented by William Moore of New York, whose family introduced it as a 'poker night' variation in the late 1950s. It represents a genre of 'waiting games' where betting is driven by the visible progression of one's hand toward a fixed goal.
